    <ul>

    <p>The <a href="https://github.com/micro2026-moa/furiosa-opt-gemma4-12B" target="_blank" rel="noopener">baseline repository</a> has been updated with the latest evaluation procedure and instructions for the supported versions.</p>

The <em>Kernel Optimization Round</em> targets three decoder-layer kernels of the model — the QKV projection, the attention output projection and the feed-forward block. Participants with the highest results advance to the <em>Model Optimization Round</em>, in which the full model is optimized end to end. The top three teams will have the opportunity to present their work at the MOA Workshop in Athens.</p>
        <p>In both rounds, submissions must pass a correctness check and are then ranked by performance. Detailed rules and evaluation criteria are specified in the <a href="https://github.com/micro2026-moa/furiosa-opt-gemma4-12B" target="_blank" rel="noopener">baseline repository</a>.</p>
